dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
Contributors: Chesapeake and Ohio Railway Company.; Poole Brothers.
Letters and numbers on border of map suggest an index is meant to accompany map. This library lacks index.
Publication statement: [S.l.] : Chesapeake & Ohio Railway Co., c1898
Restored Apr. 1963; conservation: Etherington Conservation Center, Dec. 2002.
Sept. 1966, source unknown; Feb. 2003, Map Cataloging Team.

Shows Civil War battlefields (1861-1865), Chesapeake & Ohio Railroad lines, distinguishing between those which are pre-war and post-war, other railroads during the war, plank roads, turnpikes, other roads and light houses.
This item is in the Map Collection of the Library of Virginia; please contact the Library's Archives Research Services department for more information.
dct_title_s: Map showing the location of battle fields of Virginia
